# Page title: SRX210 Factory Default Setting, A Sample - Technical Documentation - Support - Juniper Networks (a dash after Setting replaced by a comma, project rule)
# Source type: documentation
# Documentation set (page metadata): junos12.1x47
# Junos release shown: not stated (page published 2014-04-24)
# Retrieved: 2026-10-20
# Assumptions: FACTORY-1
# Note: "The following sample output shows the factory default configuration of an SRX210" (page text).
# Note: excerpt: the security policies block only, under its security parent; the page prints
# the whole configuration (system, interfaces, screen, nat, zones, vlans), left out here.
# Indentation rebuilt from the nesting of the published example (4 spaces per level).
# ---
security {
    policies {
        from-zone trust to-zone untrust {
            policy trust-to-untrust {
                match {
                    source-address any;
                    destination-address any;
                    application any;
                }
                then {
                    permit;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
